name: Mushroom Town

tiers.label: upper terrace street (orange house door in01, tower out00)

terrain_style: grassySoil tileset (layer 1): grass fringe over olive/khaki-brown cobbled dirt with grey stones; two small floating grass islets with rounded dirt undersides. Sky backdrop grassySoil back 0-3,5,6.

landmarks.what: Dark green bush on Nina's islet
Orange flowers on Nina's islet (nature/5,6 x5)
Ladder from step T2 to sky islet T5
Butterfly + orange flowers by the house
Stone archway with plank door = in01 door into 20001 (door/8 + door/10)
Tall stone chimney/oven tower with log pile and small arched door (house/chimney/3) - out00 sits at its base

notes: Portals recovered from raw WZ because the parsed API JSON has null entries: https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Map/Map0/000020000.img/portal/<n> (fields pn, pt, tm, tn, x, y). All portals here are therefore sourced, not inferred.

Landmark x,y are WZ obj anchors from https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Map/Map0/000020000.img/<layer>/obj/<n>; sprites identified via https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Obj/<oS>.img/<l0>/<l1>/<l2>/0. API-reported sprite origins were all exactly (w/2,h/2), so treat anchors as roughly sprite-centre; footprints are +-half sprite size. Where one landmark merges several objects, x,y is their approximate mean.
tiers[].y_left/y_right are MapleStory y (down is positive). Tier ids are local to this file. Ladders: y1 = top end, y2 = bottom end (raw data order); from_tier = bottom tier, to_tier = top tier.
v8 has zero mob spawns in this map (life contains only NPCs).
Spawn points x3 at (-256,122),(-207,123),(-173,125), above T1 west end.
in00 (pt 1, tm 999999999) is arrival-only: no portal back to 10000.
T4 (Nina) is 120 px above T1 with no ladder. T5 sky islet holds no objects/NPCs; it is reached only by the ladder at x=197.

v22 differs (docs/research/raw/gms_v22/20000.json): T3 extends to x=1209 (vs 939); v22 raw WZ: in01 unchanged (557,94), out00 moved to (1109,97) -> 30000:in00 (https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/22/Map/Map/Map0/000020000.img/portal/5); rest identical.
